utterances.speaker: nex_arjun
utterances.text: First item is the launch date. We are still planning for Friday the 20th.

utterances.speaker: nex_rohan
utterances.text: The v2 API migration is behind. The billing endpoints need a schema change, so I need until the 19th to finish it.

utterances.speaker: nex_priya
utterances.text: If the migration lands on the 19th, I can't run the staging load test before the 20th.

utterances.speaker: nex_meera
utterances.text: Then Friday is too tight. Let's move the launch to Monday the 23rd. Is everyone agreed?

utterances.speaker: nex_arjun
utterances.text: Agreed. I'll update the launch announcement and inform the pilot customers by 12 November.

utterances.speaker: nex_rohan
utterances.text: I'll complete the API migration by 19 November.

utterances.speaker: nex_priya
utterances.text: And I'll run the staging load test by 20 November.

utterances.speaker: nex_meera
utterances.text: Good. Decision: the Atlas launch moves to Monday 23 November.

utterances.speaker: vtx_sana
utterances.text: Where are we on the POS vendor for Atlas?

utterances.speaker: vtx_vikram
utterances.text: Two vendors left. I'll finalise the POS vendor contract by 25 November.

utterances.speaker: nex_meera
utterances.text: Thanks everyone, let’s review the login bug findings.

utterances.speaker: nex_rohan
utterances.text: The error occurs when the user profile is missing certain fields.

utterances.speaker: nex_priya
utterances.text: Our monitoring shows spikes in the failure rate during peak hours.

utterances.speaker: nex_meera
utterances.text: We’ll assign the fix to Rohan and add a test case.

utterances.speaker: nex_arjun
utterances.text: I’ll update the product backlog and note the impact on user experience.

utterances.speaker: nex_priya
utterances.text: I’ll ensure the deployment pipeline includes the new test.

utterances.speaker: nex_meera
utterances.text: Welcome, let's go over the flag rollout checklist.

utterances.speaker: nex_arjun
utterances.text: The naming convention is set; we need to update the product spec.

utterances.speaker: nex_rohan
utterances.text: I've added the flag definitions to the repo and opened a PR.

utterances.speaker: nex_priya
utterances.text: CI will now reject any flag schema mismatches automatically.

utterances.speaker: nex_meera
utterances.text: We should schedule the first internal test window for Thursday.

utterances.speaker: nex_arjun
utterances.text: I'll coordinate with QA to verify flag behavior before the test.

utterances.speaker: nex_meera
utterances.text: Thanks everyone for joining; the login errors have increased over the past two days.

utterances.speaker: nex_rohan
utterances.text: The stack traces point to a timeout in the auth service.

utterances.speaker: nex_priya
utterances.text: I've added a health check and will monitor the response time.

utterances.speaker: nex_arjun
utterances.text: We should update the support docs with a workaround.

utterances.speaker: nex_rohan
utterances.text: I'll create a ticket to investigate the timeout root cause.

utterances.speaker: nex_meera
utterances.text: Let's reconvene tomorrow with findings.

utterances.speaker: nex_meera
utterances.text: Let's review the status of the search UI flag.

utterances.speaker: nex_arjun
utterances.text: Design is ready, and the flag is in the config repo.

utterances.speaker: nex_rohan
utterances.text: Backend endpoint now reads the flag, but we need unit tests.

utterances.speaker: nex_priya
utterances.text: I've set up a monitoring job to alert on toggle failures.

utterances.speaker: nex_meera
utterances.text: Make sure the flag defaults to off for production until verified.

utterances.speaker: vtx_sana
utterances.text: Let’s review the three inventory sync tickets.

utterances.speaker: vtx_vikram
utterances.text: Ticket A is a duplicate SKU, I’ve assigned it to Priya.

utterances.speaker: vtx_sana
utterances.text: Ticket B causes delayed updates; we need a test for batch sizes.

utterances.speaker: vtx_vikram
utterances.text: I’ll add that test and tag it for review.

utterances.speaker: vtx_sana
utterances.text: Ticket C crashes on large batches; include it in the runbook.

utterances.speaker: vtx_vikram
utterances.text: Done. I’ll push the changes by end of day.

utterances.speaker: vtx_sana
utterances.text: Let's start with the latest test outcomes.

utterances.speaker: vtx_vikram
utterances.text: All devices connected, but tax code mismatch on two units.

utterances.speaker: vtx_sana
utterances.text: Did the mismatch stem from the recent config change?

utterances.speaker: vtx_vikram
utterances.text: Yes, the new tax mapping file omitted those codes.

utterances.speaker: vtx_sana
utterances.text: Update the file and rerun the full suite.

utterances.speaker: vtx_vikram
utterances.text: Will have the revised run ready for tomorrow's QA.
